correctness.rationale: Exact divisor-count factorization, fixed-fiber density, Euler-product normalization and powerful-tail bound are proved in RESULT.md. A standard squarefree fixed-exclusion Erdos–Kac theorem is derived from its Dirichlet series and Selberg–Delange; conditional convergence plus uniform truncation proves joint independence. Numerical verification independently checked 200000 exact identities. No moment-convergence claim is made.

value.rationale: A motivated second-order theorem beyond a 2026 first-order reciprocal average: the centered iterated-divisor count has an explicit genuinely non-Gaussian scale mixture, while conditioning on a powerful-part environment gives independent Gaussian fluctuations. The result characterizes all fixed powerful fibers and the smallest-scale Euler-product atom; not a routine numerical evaluation or a mere reformulation of one averaged constant.
